opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Up to £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three

opportunities.eligibility_summary: For early career researchers, with a research record but who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post, to undertake a significant piece of publishable work. Applicants must not yet have held a full-time permanent academic post in a UK university or non-UK institution, nor may Fellows hold such a post concurrently with the Early Career Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships are tenable for 3 years on a full-time basis. The Trust will support requests to hold the award part-time over a proportionately longer period for health-related reasons, disability or childcare commitments.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For UK universities to fund up to 30 Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area for that institution. The scheme is open to applications from any UK university that holds research degree awarding powers in its own right.
opportunities.summary: The scheme is open to applications from any UK university that holds research degree awarding powers in its own right. Each award provides funds for 18 four-year Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships at UK/home rates and 6 four-year Scholarships at international/overseas rates.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research. Applicants must hold a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that will extend beyond the duration of the Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Research Fellowships are open to experienced researchers, particularly those who are or have been prevented by routine duties from completing a programme of original research. Fellowships are tenable for between 3 and 24 months.
